data.one_liner: Dart library for parsing, validating, and formatting international phone numbers.
data.what_it_does: Parses phone numbers using Google's libPhoneNumber metadata across all platforms instantly without native method channels. It allows validating numbers by type, formatting them per country, finding phone numbers inside text, and managing phone number ranges.
use_when: You need to validate user-entered phone numbers against specific country rules.
You want to format national or international phone numbers correctly.
You need to extract phone numbers from arbitrary text blocks.
avoid_when: You require complex carrier routing or interactive telephony dialing features.
strengths: Supports all platforms instantly without requiring native platform channels.
Uses up-to-date metadata from Google's libPhoneNumber project.
Provides helper utilities like phone number ranges and text extraction.
weaknesses: Metadata must be periodically upgraded to include recent numbering plan changes.
